asset.name: Avalanche

score_rationales.institutional: AVAX has achieved strong institutional infrastructure milestones — VanEck's spot ETF (VAVX) launched Jan 2026, CME AVAX futures live May 2026, Coinbase/BNY Mellon custody, Avalanche Treasury Co. (~$675M Nasdaq vehicle), $2.1B in tokenized RWAs, and backing from Galaxy, Pantera, BlackRock BUIDL, and Franklin Templeton — but corporate treasury adoption remains thin and ETF AUM is nascent compared to BTC/ETH benchmarks.
score_rationales.regulatory: AVAX received explicit digital commodity classification in the March 2026 SEC/CFTC joint final rule, eliminating its securities overhang; VanEck's spot AVAX ETF (VAVX) launched January 2026 with staking rewards, CME AVAX futures went live May 2026, and permissioned subnet architecture provides institutional-grade KYC/AML compliance rails — the main residual risk is pending ETF approvals from Bitwise/Grayscale still facing custody and market-manipulation review delays.
score_rationales.supply: AVAX has a hard-capped max supply of 720M (bullish structural floor), and the 93.2% circulating/total ratio signals minimal near-term insider or team overhang. However, only ~60% of the max supply is currently in circulation, leaving ~256M tokens to be emitted as staking rewards — an ongoing inflation tail of roughly 2–4% annually that dampens the fixed-cap benefit. High staking participation (typically 50–60% of circulating supply locked as validators) meaningfully compresses liquid float and partially offsets future emission pressure, but no exchange reserve trend data was available to assess whether coins are actively moving to cold storage.

score_rationales.adoption_activity: Avalanche shows credible adoption recovery with ~$2.77B DeFi TVL (+53% QoQ), ~1.7M daily active addresses, 75+ active subnets (+158% YoY), and $1.3B tokenized asset TVL—anchored by institutional momentum (Progmat $2B migration, CME futures launch May 2026); penalized relative to peers for TVL still well below 2021-22 peak and meaningful L2 competition compressing its generalist-chain narrative.
